name: assay
description: Blind trial bench for model selection. Runs one workload across every model on the bench in parallel with the names shuffled to letters, scores the anonymised outputs with a blind examiner, measures token cost and latency, then reveals which model earned which column and folds the crown into a personal routing policy.
_comment: Swap tool_id for the minted id: node ../../scripts/set-tool-id.mjs apply --tool <minted-id>. distribution.active is binary: scripts/build-binaries.mjs builds one self-contained executable per platform with Node's single executable application support, so the Cloud Agent needs no language runtime installed. Run `npm run binaries`, then `anna-app executa upload-binaries`. The npm and local profiles stay declared for development; use --profile npm to publish the package for a harness that runs its own Node.
